baseline_kinds.static: versioned normative rules and approved thresholds
baseline_kinds.dynamic: versioned statistics learned from an immutable eligible sample snapshot

invariants: static normative baselines and dynamic behavior baselines have separate explicit kind and version identities
a definition moves learning to frozen only after sample eligibility, quality, minimum count, closed window and source watermark checks pass
activation requires an immutable frozen version, expected definition revision, independent approval and all target consumer acknowledgements
learning or failed versions are never used for online inference
an active version is immutable; rebuild creates a new version and never mutates the active snapshot
drift evaluation binds baseline version, as_of, window, thresholds, observed value, deviation, quality and evidence references
missing, expired or partial active baseline is fail-visible and never silently falls back to an unversioned statistic
retirement preserves history and the previous stable version for rollback
domain.compensation: stop activation dispatch, restore the previous fully acknowledged immutable version, retain the failed candidate and reconcile every consumer acknowledgement

data.migration: deployments/postgres/migrations/202608141800_m07_behavior_baseline_v1.sql; existing compatibility tables remain in common/sql/pg/08-behavior-baseline.sql

negative_tests: cross-tenant definition, sample, version, approval or acknowledgement is rejected
the build requester cannot approve activation
expired approval, stale definition revision and partial target acknowledgement are rejected
an active or retired version cannot be mutated in place

stop_conditions: sample leakage or future data is observed, quality gate is partial, acknowledgement is incomplete, inference P99 or resource budget exceeds the approved candidate

tests: G1 state machine, authorization, revision and immutable-version tests
G2 real closed-window sample snapshot and deterministic rebuild
G3 consumer-first shadow inference with version and evidence
G4 all-target ACK activation and previous-version rollback
G5 K8s canary, failure injection and observation
evidence: candidate-bound definition revision, sample manifest, baseline version hash, approvals, consumer ACK exact set, inference receipts, rollback receipt and observation window
